materials.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color / albedo texture for a high-fidelity real-time 3D Chinese classical movable-type printing workshop. Generate a single 2048 x 2048 square image, ultra-detailed true orthographic flat scan of finished dark walnut wood, covering the entire canvas edge to edge. Warm medium-dark brown walnut, not black and not orange, refined long straight natural grain running vertically, fine pores and very subtle gentle grain waviness. Historical crafted workbench quality, clean satin wood color only, restrained small color variation. This is ONLY the wood surface base color, no boards, no plank seams, no knots or high-contrast distinctive repeated features. Perfectly even diffuse illumination across the entire image; no shadows, no cast light, no highlights, no specular lighting, no gradient, no ambient occlusion, no camera perspective or vignette. Must tile seamlessly on all four edges with matching surface pattern continuity, no visible border. No objects, letters, printing, marks, stains, chips, scratches, frame, watermarks or illustrative styling. Photographically real microscopic surface detail, a uniform production texture map.
